string-array.item: Dionysus (Διόνυσος, God of Wine and Madness)
Hermes (Ἑρμῆς, God of Messengers and Trickery)

string-array.name: list_desc_detailed_text
string-array.item: Brilliant daughter of Athena, known for her intelligence, leadership, and strategic mind. She is a skilled architect and planner who often saves her friends through logic and careful thinking.
God of war who represents the violent, brutal side of battle. He thrives on conflict and chaos, often manipulating others to start wars and prove his strength.
Goddess of wisdom, battle strategy, and craftsmanship. She values intelligence over brute force and guides heroes who rely on cleverness and skill.
Wise and experienced centaur who serves as the director of Camp Half-Blood. He trains demigods, offers guidance, and helps protect young heroes from mythical dangers.
Fearsome warrior and daughter of Ares who is strong, competitive, and battle-hardened. She struggles between her tough exterior and her loyalty to friends.
God of wine, madness, and unpredictable behavior. Though often sarcastic and grumpy as camp director, he hides surprising depth and ancient power.
Loyal satyr and protector who dedicates his life to guarding demigods. Though nervous and comedic, he is brave, caring, and deeply committed to his friends.
Trickster messenger god known for speed, cleverness, and mischief. He delivers messages for the gods and often bends rules for fun or personal gain.
Skilled swordsman who struggles with his past, family legacy, and loyalty. He constantly battles inner conflict while trying to prove himself as a true hero.
Cursed monster with snake hair whose gaze turns people to stone. Once a victim of divine punishment, she represents tragedy, anger, and revenge.
Heroic son of Poseidon with the ability to control water. Brave, loyal, and determined, he leads quests and fights to protect both humans and gods.
God of the sea, earthquakes, and storms. Powerful and commanding, he is both a caring father and a distant ruler of the oceans.
Punished king forced to hold the weight of the sky as eternal torment. He represents endurance, suffering, and the cost of defying the gods.
Powerful daughter of Zeus who commands electricity and lightning. Confident and strong-willed, she proves herself as a capable and determined hero.
Kind-hearted cyclops who helps build magical weapons and tools. Though gentle and misunderstood, he is loyal, creative, and devoted to his friends.
